jalapeño ja·la·pe·ño | ˌhaləˈpān(y)ō, ˌhäləˈpān(y)ō, ˌhaləˈpēn(y)ō, ˌhäləˈpēn(y)ō | (also jalapeño pepper) noun (plural jalapeños) a very hot green chili pepper, used especially in Mexican cooking: order extra jalapeños on the side | [mass noun] : arrange the garlic and jalapeño in a layer | [as modifier] : a jalapeño dressing. ORIGIN from Mexican Spanish (chile) jalapeño.
